claims.claim: metrics.NewCollector(CollectorOpts{Registerer, Namespace, ConstLabels, InstanceLabels}); Namespace default promptkit; Registerer default DefaultRegisterer
Provider metrics carry provider, model labels (original) / provider, model, source (true)

Audio counters audio_frame_underruns_total, audio_frame_underrun_samples_total, audio_frame_drops_total{direction,reason=overflow}, audio_pacing_behind_deadline_total registered by NewCollector; direction is input/output; metric table descriptions follow the Help strings in stream_metrics.go

metrics.NewEventBusHealthCollector(bus, ns, constLabels) exports eventbus_events_dropped_total with no labels, read at scrape time; counts events dropped because the bus buffer or a listener queue was full, once per listener
NewEvalOnlyCollector equals NewCollector with DisablePipelineMetrics; sdk.EvaluateOpts has MetricsCollector and MetricsInstanceLabels

Dashboard includes Active Pipelines and stage panels backed by promptkit_pipelines_active, promptkit_stage_duration_seconds, promptkit_stage_elements_total
Pipeline, provider, tool and validation metrics are event-derived and under-report when the bus drops; audio and eventbus counters are direct
